msgs:
KNOW THYSELF.
- SOCRATES

THE JOURNEY OF
A THOUSAND MILES
BEGINS WITH
ONE STEP. - LAO TZU

BREVITY IS THE
SOUL OF WIT.
- SHAKESPEARE

NOTHING IS
PERMANENT EXCEPT
CHANGE. - HERACLITUS
Haste makes waste

Measure twice,
cut once

Better late
than never

A friend in need
is a friend indeed

Actions speak
louder than words

Practice makes
perfect

Rome wasn't built
in a day

Where there's a will,
there's a way
No pain, no gain

Every cloud has
a silver lining

Don't count your
chickens before
they hatch

Two heads are
better than one

Honesty is the
best policy

Slow and steady
wins the race

Don't judge a book
by its cover

All that glitters
is not gold

Look before
you leap
Silence is golden

Knowledge is power.
- F. Bacon

I know that
I know nothing.
- Socrates

Everything flows.
- Heraclitus

A journey of a
thousand miles
begins with
one step. - Lao Tzu

He who knows
others is wise.
He who knows himself
is enlightened.
- Lao Tzu

To be or
not to be?
- Shakespeare

All the world's
a stage.
- Shakespeare

I think, therefore
I am.
- Descartes

Life is short,
art is long.
- Hippocrates

The best is the
enemy of the good.
- Voltaire

We must cultivate
our garden.
- Voltaire

While we delay,
life speeds by.
- Seneca

Our life is what
our thoughts make it.
- Marcus Aurelius

It is not things
that disturb us,
but our opinions.
- Epictetus

Time is money.
- B. Franklin

Well done is better
than well said.
- B. Franklin

Nothing in excess.
- Solon

Friendship is one
soul in two bodies.
- Aristotle

It doesn't matter
how slowly you go
as long as you
don't stop

Happy families are
all alike.
- L. Tolstoy

Habit is second
nature

This too
shall pass

The wise learn from
others' mistakes
Kindness comes back
Seeing is believing

Do unto others
as you'd have them
do unto you

Many hands make
light work

Still waters
run deep

The early bird
catches the worm

When in Rome,
do as the
Romans do

Easy come,
easy go

Patience is
a virtue

Good things come
to those who wait

Necessity is the
mother of invention

There's no place
like home

Laughter is the
best medicine

Beauty is in the
eye of the beholder

Fortune favors
the bold

You reap what
you sow

Strike while the
iron is hot

An ounce of
prevention is worth
a pound of cure

A picture is worth
a thousand words

Variety is the
spice of life

Better safe
than sorry

Where there's smoke,
there's fire

Don't put all your
eggs in one basket

The pen is mightier
than the sword

Great minds
think alike

Every day is
a little life

Gratitude is the
memory of the heart

Wisdom comes
with experience

Deep rivers
flow quietly

Patience is bitter,
its fruit is sweet

Great things begin
small

A smile is the
shortest distance
between people

To forgive is
to be strong

Where love is,
there is joy

Simplicity is
genius

Well begun is
half done

Who talks much
does little

A good example
is the best sermon

A craftsman never
fears the work

Old friends are
the best friends

A kind word
warms for
three winters

Learn as if you
were to live forever

Begin with
the end in mind

Small deeds done
beat great deeds
planned

The best time to
plant a tree was
20 years ago.
The next is now

Dig the well before
you are thirsty

Happiness is a
journey, not
a destination

What you seek
is seeking you

Make hay while
the sun shines

Keep your friends
close

The more you know,
the less you need

Words fly,
writing stays

Tomorrow is
a new day
Nobody is perfect

Learn from yesterday,
live for today

Fall seven times,
stand up eight

A rolling stone
gathers no moss

Prepare the sled
in summer

Look on the
bright side

Hope for the best,
prepare for
the worst

Every master was
once a disaster
Health is wealth

Don't cry over
spilled milk

It takes two
to tango

Count your
blessings

Kindness costs
nothing

Silence is also
an answer

Deeds make
the person

Choose a job you
love and never
work a day.
- Confucius

A word is enough
to the wise
Truth will out

Good fences make
good neighbors

Time heals
all wounds

Home is where
the heart is

A merry heart does
good like medicine

Love is patient,
love is kind

To everything
there is a season

Take it one
day at a time
Be the change
